text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and D after sizable gains felt satisfying, but I should not sell just to lock in a gain; consider each stock’s outlook and my overall plan.","I should avoid holding a position simply because admitting a purchase was a mistake feels painful. Reassess it objectively, including when it is at a loss.","Short-term account changes can be modest or volatile; I should make deliberate decisions rather than trade frequently in response to daily fluctuations."]}
